body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Legendary artist and producer Dr. Dre, Interscope Geffen A&M Chairman Jimmy Iovine and Monster announced the official introduction of 'Beats Tour' the newest addition to the popular Beats by Dr. Dre family of high-resolution, high-style headphones at CES 2009.

Dr. Dre, Jimmy Iovine and Monster teamed up to create Beats by Dr. Dre in order to provide consumers with a brand new level of headphone audio performance with extreme clarity, deep bass and full power which had been lacking in conventional headphones.
Beats Tour, the new sealed in-ear design of Beats by Dr. Dre, are an innovative new type of in-ear style headphones designed to literally reduce external noise for a better music experience.
And for total user convenience, they feature Monster's unique Tangle Free Cable, an innovative, patent-pending cable design, offering total user comfort and hassle-free listening enjoyment.
Beats Tour headphones come with a compact and rugged carrying case for safe storage. They carry a suggested retail price of $149.95.
